items.title: Louis Armstrong: Jazz Casual Interview, 1964-07-10
items.q: You know, sometime, like Bessie Smith, I remember, she'd just stay in the studio and write the blues as she finished one, just write another one.

ctx.x: Did she have these things planned out as regular tunes? Well, she probably had her blues.

Yeah. You know, sometime, like Bessie Smith, I remember, she'd just stay in the studio and write the blues as she finished one, just write another one. Just write another one. Yeah. And all we gotta do is wait until she finishes, that's the, like, a man don't love me no more, and then we da-da-do-da-do-da-do-da. It was nice, though.
Did Bessie come from R. Rainey? Is that where she came from as a singer?
